content: “Ŋaisag teig muroug, tamag muroug, kududom agurep, ŋaisag ru itargiranag san naom na ŋiŋeŋ dop aloŋ.”
Saen Pol Hibru lo ru irupidai dugo duloŋ man, abaŋ fidian kute ibol a. Agog Pol ibol,

“Ŋai man Juda tamol, Silisia na taun yaŋan Tarsus dubol dak lo ŋilasa ya. Gug etna Jerusalem na tamol ŋigane ya. Gamaliel iŋ ŋaisag girek maŋau. Ŋai idsad tubud baged sad kubiaeŋ ŋuri ŋupani san ru dabai geig ŋaloŋ se ya. Aŋ Anut awan ari apani dak ago mi ŋai dam awan ŋuri ŋupani da.
Ŋai ŋabol dugo, tamol Jesus o ilod rumok an mala suek ŋupidinai dugo, aenkadi duburoug subanek ab lo didirai a. Agod aenta dufu dumat na ya.

Pris malan te yak, iŋ kaunsil fidian dida ru rumok ŋabol dan duloŋ a. Ak niŋen o ka dubol dop aloŋ a. Iŋ ŋai girek dupanag go idsad Juda tamolpein Damaskus na dumado dan sad na ŋisini ŋau. Girek an tamolpein ŋuburoup sein nam dusubanaip, ŋaŋal pe, Jerusalem na mupalup muruan disini san ibol a.”
Pol Kris ilasa yak niŋen o ibol a
“Gug nal ta ad titiŋae Damaskus sumeik ŋupani dugo, lilaman ta malan geig ak irakilawi.
Agog tan na ŋau ŋadug, awan ta iwagiŋ go ibol, ‘Sol, Sol! Ata wo ŋai malag sue dak i?’
“Agog ŋai ŋusumiaeŋ, ‘Tubun en, oŋ enti?’” “Agog awag yabig ibol, ‘Ŋai Jesus, Nasaret tamol amaiak malag sue da.’
Tamol ŋai dida mau an lilaman dile gug awak a ŋai da miŋiŋeŋ an awan ta duloŋ na ya.”
“Agog ŋusumiani, ‘Tubun en, dugo ŋigane wak i?’” “Agog Tubun en irupaiag, ‘Masap, Damaskus na wau gup, Tubun en san ilon oŋ lo dugo isou dan fidian durupaio uloŋ a.’
Lilaman an malan kasik an lo ŋai malag tidom tubun, agog abaŋ ŋile san tia ya. Ago tag turag muroug dida mau an banig te diabig dida Damaskus na mau a.”
“Agog tamol ta yaŋan Ananaias, iŋ pempem Anut san ubou ile da. Iŋ idsad kubiaeŋ kagin ipani da. Juda tamolpein Damaskus na dumado dan iŋ Ananaias yaŋan diabisa da.
Iŋ ŋaisag na ipalug, siŋireg na itur dugug ibol, ‘O teig Sol, mala ipuk pe abaŋ ule.’ Ago ibol ak nek saen an lo mi malag ipuk go iŋ ŋile ya.
Agog irupaiag, ‘Id tubud baged sad Anut oŋ iŋsan ilon uloŋ o ipiliano ya. Ago dugo iŋanen Tamol Itaotan an ule san, agod iŋanen awan uloŋ o dam ipiliano ya.
Man dugo, melmel a ule uloŋ na yan, iŋ patun fo utur dop tamolpein fidian ta duloŋ na yan rupidai duloŋ a.
Ago yak niŋen ata wo mala gane dak i? Masap, suguek ŋanep, iŋanen yaŋan lo gudani dop, oŋane aupasek ipasi yau a.’”
“Agog ŋai ŋamul Jerusalem na ŋaug, tempel lo ŋugudani dugo, malag ŋutun ŋile ya.
Malag ŋutun lo Tubun en ŋaisag na iŋiŋeŋ dugo ŋile ya. Agog ibol, ‘Ririan Jerusalem bisei. Man dugo, tamolpein etna ŋai niŋeg o ubol ilasa dan uyan ta dupani na wa.’”
“Ago tag ŋai awan ŋabig ŋabol, ‘Tubun en, iŋ duloŋ ak, ŋai ubou ab fidian ilon lo ŋiladu ŋilasa dugo, tamolpein oŋ o ilod rumok se yan ŋibiaig ŋafu idu na ya.
Agod saen Stiven pat nam dufuni imat man, ŋai iŋ siŋired na ŋatur dugo uyan ŋupidinai a, ago dugo a dufuni se yan sad kulos kagin ŋupani se ya.’
Gug Tubun en irupaiag, ‘Wau. Ŋai ŋidinop, asau geig tamolpein a Juda tia yan sad na wau a.’”
Pol Rom tamol ta

Tamolpein fidian Pol san ru an duloŋ yau nag, ru ta a tamolpein Juda tia yan niŋedi wo ibol an duloŋ go ilod imoi geig a. An lo afon awad tubun mi disasai dugo dubol, “Agane imat. Tamol naon ago man imado san ta idaisuda na ya.”

Tamolpein fidian disasaig, iŋsad kulos dubal dugo gufgaf dam disinig lak na dubal isida se ya. Ago tag Rom san yu gurman an ibol dugo Pol diŋaneg, yu tamol sad ŋioŋ ab ilon lo diladu ya. Yu gurman an iŋsan yu tamol irupidaig, Pol rasau nam dufuni dop ata mel niŋen o doup disasai se yan fun ibol ilasa dop iloŋ o ago igane ya.
Gug dirae didarig bu dupani wo digane dugo, Pol yu gurman ta siŋiren na itur dan isumiani, “Dugo, kubiaeŋ dugo ibol dak i? Rom tamol ta kot lo sumianek gamugo pani dop ka funi wak i?”
Yu gurman ru an iloŋ tag Rom san yu gurman tubun an san na yaug isumiani, “Oŋ dugo gane wo dak i? Tamol an iŋ Rom tamol.”
Ago tag yu gurman tubun an Pol san na yaug isumiani, “Rupaiag ŋaloŋ. Oŋ Rom tamol ak i?” Agog Pol ibol, “Awo.”

Rom san yu gurman tubun an irupei, “Moni naon lak na yak nam Rom gabman ŋupani dugo ate Rom tamol igo ŋilasa ya.” Agog Pol ibol, “Ŋai tinag tamag iŋ Rom tamolpein, ago yak niŋen o ŋai dam mi Rom tamol.”

Ago ibol ak yu tamol a Pol bu dupani wo dutur an gamu nam dusuksuk diau a. Rom san yu gurman tubun an dam irer saian. Man dugo, Pol Rom tamol ak gug sumianek tia ka ibol dugo sein nam dusubani an ilo sou man iŋane ya.
Pol Juda sad kaunsil malad lo itur a

Yu gurman tubun an ata mel niŋen o Juda tamolpein Pol dufuni imat o disasai na yan fun abaŋ ile wo igane. Ago tag tidom lom mi ibol dugo pris gurman adi iŋ kaunsil dida dutumani a. Agog Pol banin na sein digane yan dupasig, diŋane diaug naod na dugunig itur a.
